title: MORGELON
logline: In the Colorado gold, the forest is one body, the altitude agrees for you, and every perfect drone shot finishes the harvest.
disclaimer: Fiction · Colorado mountain horror concepts · not medical advice

shots.narration: Below the grade, they still tell you to leave.
shots.on_screen: There is nothing in your skin.
shots.support: Visitor center. Clinic. Denial before the switchbacks.

shots.narration: Not infection — graft. The Single Tree finds skin.
shots.support: The Fly’s wet practical. Never a cartoon mushroom.

shots.narration: Thin air does not confuse them. It makes them agree.
Radios overlap. Tracks converge. The grade edits the party.
shots.support: Action-cam breath. Calm faces in cutaways.

shots.narration: They came for the gold. Their looking finishes the harvest.
A thousand trunks. One genome. Trees in the blood of the mountain.
The appearance of mischief is evidence enough with power.
shots.on_screen: Keep the GOLD card — or delete and descend alone.
shots.support: Evidence is a weapon. Consensus is a countdown.
